responsibility: Implements BIR-side lowering of Rust pattern bindings into newly declared places and assignments. It walks HIR patterns used in let statements, parameters, and similar binding contexts, creates variables with the correct ref/mut form, derives field, tuple, slice, dereference, and tuple-struct subpaths from an initializer place, propagates optional type annotations and free-region information through nested pattern structure, and emits the assignments that connect destructured values to their bound locals.
